extensions.referenceNotes: Tonal ramps are catalog references, not extra runtime tokens. CSS snippets are light-mode Flutter catalog approximations, not shader reproductions. Runtime source and DESIGN.md primitives are normative. Text-rich optical overlays use an 88% veil; explicit clear controls use 57% light / 76% dark, contrast gradients and a specular rim. The dock protectText veil grades from clear rim opacity to 94% centrally at stops 0/0.22/0.8/1; home clear controls retain the uniform veil. Dark touch light peaks at 6% white, light at 38%. Bounded shader refraction uses 25 Gaussian samples at approximately 3dp sigma and up to 2.5dp rim displacement, with sigma-7 blur fallback. Host Impeller tests exercised the active shader filter; Android rendering and physical GPU profiling remain separate.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: Catalog equivalent of Flutter FilledButton; runtime Flutter is normative.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height:56px; padding:0 24px; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:#6C3B5D; color:#fff; font:700 15px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-primary:hover { background:#7F4A70; } .ds-primary:active { filter:brightness(.95); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6C3B5D; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-primary:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

components.name: Outlined button
components.css: .ds-outlined { min-height:56px; padding:0 24px; border:1px solid #E1D7D4; border-radius:16px; background:transparent; color:#29232A; font:700 15px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-outlined:hover { background:#F0EAE4; } .ds-outlined:active { background:#EFE1E8; } .ds-outlined:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6C3B5D; outline-offset:3px; } .ds-outlined:disabled { opacity:.45; cursor:default; }

components.name: Input
components.description: Raised field with explicit label and focus border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Your name<input class="ds-input" placeholder="Enter your name"></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display:grid; gap:8px; color:#615760; font:400 14px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:48px; padding:18px 16px; color:#29232A; background:#F0EAE4; border:1px solid #94818C; border-radius:16px; font:400 16px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif; caret-color:#6C3B5D; } .ds-input::placeholder { color:#756A73; } .ds-input:hover { border-color:#615760; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:none; border:1.5px solid #6C3B5D; } .ds-input:disabled { opacity:.45; }

components.name: Selected choice chip
components.description: Selected duration/caller; white text on plum in light mode.
components.css: .ds-chip { min-height:48px; padding:8px 12px; background:#6C3B5D; color:#fff; border:1px solid #E1D7D4; border-radius:999px; font:600 13px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background:#7F4A70; } .ds-chip:active { filter:brightness(.95); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6C3B5D; outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Content surface
components.description: Solid default content material. Optical refraction is reserved for floating controls.
components.css: .ds-glass { min-height:80px; padding:16px; border:1px solid #E1D7D4; border-radius:20px; color:#29232A; background:#FFFDFA; font:700 16px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif; text-align:left; cursor:pointer; transition:transform 140ms ease-out; } .ds-glass:hover { border-color:#6C3B5D; } .ds-glass:active { transform:scale(.985); } .ds-glass:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6C3B5D; outline-offset:3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-glass { transition:none; } .ds-glass:active { transform:none; } }

components.name: Floating dock
components.description: Light catalog approximation of the graded text-protection veil. Flutter adds bounded refraction, local touch light and the 240ms selection glide; this CSS does not reproduce its shader.
components.css: .ds-dock { display:flex; padding:6px; border:1.25px solid rgba(255,255,255,.78); border-radius:24px; background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.32),rgba(255,255,255,.01) 55%,rgba(255,255,255,.10)),linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(255,253,250,.57),rgba(255,253,250,.94) 22%,rgba(255,253,250,.94) 80%,rgba(255,253,250,.57)); backdrop-filter:blur(7px); box-shadow:0 8px 24px -4px rgba(41,35,42,.10); } .ds-dock button { flex:1; min-width:48px; min-height:64px; padding:4px; border:0; border-radius:18px; background:transparent; color:#29232A; font:500 11px/1.2 Inter,sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-dock button[aria-current] { background:rgba(239,225,232,.78); color:#6C3B5D; font-weight:700; } .ds-dock button:hover { background:rgba(239,225,232,.5); } .ds-dock button:active { background:#EFE1E8; } .ds-dock button:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6C3B5D; outline-offset:3px; } @media (prefers-contrast:more) { .ds-dock { background:#FFFDFA; backdrop-filter:none; border-color:#94818C; } }

components.name: SOS control
components.description: Solid rose visual sample; this catalog button sends no alert.
components.css: .ds-sos { width:220px; height:220px; border:0; border-radius:50%; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#E11D48,#BE123C); color:#fff; font:700 55px/1 Manrope,sans-serif; letter-spacing:4.4px; box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(190,18,60,.16); cursor:pointer; transition:transform 150ms ease-out; } .ds-sos:hover { filter:brightness(1.03); } .ds-sos:active { transform:scale(.94); } .ds-sos:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #6C3B5D; outline-offset:3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-sos { transition:none; } .ds-sos:active { transform:none; } }

narrative.northStar: Warm ivory, deep plum, clear glass
narrative.overview:
On 23 October 2026 the owner replaced the earlier dark-first direction with warm
ivory and deep plum, then requested the clear Liquid Glass appearance seen in
current iOS references. The Android app retains this light layout and uses optical
glass for floating controls. Plum carries ordinary actions; rose keeps SOS distinct.
The shield-and-flame mark and bundled typography retain the Shakti identity.

This is a Flutter Android task interface. Material 3 controls, system navigation,
safe areas and readable instructions govern its behavior. Apple materials inform
its optical treatment; the Flutter rendering is a project implementation with a
blur fallback. It does not establish Apple rendering parity or handset performance.
Runtime source is normative. This file and `.impeccable/design.json` describe
`app/`; `web/DESIGN.md` governs the website. Frontmatter pixel values represent
Flutter logical dp, with system text scaling applied separately.
keyCharacteristics: Warm ivory light mode by default, with persisted Light, Dark and System choices.
Clear floating navigation and map controls above solid, quiet content surfaces.
Bundled Manrope headings and Inter body text, with restrained hierarchy.
Immediate safety actions, readable state labels and reduced-motion alternatives.

rules.name: The Emergency Priority Rule
rules.body: Keep SOS clearly labeled and visually dominant; decoration and navigation never delay an emergency callback.

rules.name: The Bounded Material Rule
rules.body: Keep refraction and blur clipped to floating controls; ordinary content groups stay solid, and accessibility fallbacks stay opaque.

dos: Do resolve feature colors through semantic roles in both appearances.
Do preserve 48 dp targets, semantic actions and the visible SOS cancellation control.
Do keep content ink opaque and accessibility glass fallbacks solid.
Do verify narrow screens, 200% text, dark appearance and real populated data.
Do distinguish software fallback renders, host Impeller renders and Android device verification.
donts: Don't delay emergency actions for animation, network access or optional preferences.
Don't extend backdrop refraction or blur to ordinary content rows or the whole page.
Don't invent contacts, readiness, delivery confirmations or live service results.
Don't reintroduce the removed volume/accessibility trigger.
Don't treat static screenshots as proof of smoothness, Apple parity or Play Protect approval.
